mod show;

pub use index::index;
pub use show::show;

=== create src/controllers/blog/index.rs
//! `GET /blog`. Generated by `cargo offrails generate controller blog index show:/blog/{slug}`.

use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::views::{self, Ctx, blog::BlogIndex};

/// `GET /blog`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn index(
    ctx: Ctx,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    Ok(views::render(BlogIndex {
        ctx: ctx.titled("Blog"),
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create templates/blog/index.html
{% extends "layouts/application.html" %}

{% call ui::page_header("Blog") %}{% endcall %}
<p>APP: what this page shows (templates/blog/index.html).</p>
{% endblock %}

=== create src/controllers/blog/show.rs
//! `GET /blog/{slug}`. Generated by `cargo offrails generate controller blog index show:/blog/{slug}`.

use axum::{
    extract::Path,
    response::{IntoResponse, Response},
};

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::views::{self, Ctx, blog::BlogShow};

/// `GET /blog/{slug}`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn show(
    ctx: Ctx,
    Path(slug): Path<String>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    Ok(views::render(BlogShow {
        ctx: ctx.titled("Blog show"),
        slug,
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create templates/blog/show.html
{% extends "layouts/application.html" %}
{% import "components/ui.html" as ui %}
{% block content %}
{% call ui::page_header("Blog show") %}{% endcall %}
<p>APP: what this page shows for <code>{{ slug }}</code> (templates/blog/show.html).</p>
{% endblock %}

=== create src/views/blog.rs
//! Page structs for blog. Generated by `cargo offrails generate controller blog index show:/blog/{slug}`.

use askama::Template;

use super::Ctx;
// The layout links with `paths::`.
use crate::routes::paths;

/// `GET /blog`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "blog/index.html")]
pub struct BlogIndex {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
}

/// `GET /blog/{slug}`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "blog/show.html")]
pub struct BlogShow {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
    /// From the path (`{slug}`): untrusted; Askama escapes it.
    pub slug: String,
}

=== wire src/views/mod.rs @ samples: view mods
pub mod blog; // blog

=== create src/routes/blog.rs
//! Blog (`cargo offrails generate controller blog`): its router, `paths::` helpers and `ROUTES` rows.
//! src/routes.rs wires it in with one `// blog` line at `route mods`, `routes`, `paths`, `route tables`.

use axum::{Router, routing::get};

use super::{Access, Route};
use crate::state::AppState;

pub fn router() -> Router<AppState> {
    Router::new()
        .route("/blog", get(crate::controllers::blog::index))
        .route("/blog/{slug}", get(crate::controllers::blog::show))
}

/// URL helpers; `crate::routes::paths` re-exports them.
pub mod paths {
    pub fn blog() -> String {
        "/blog".into()
    }

    pub fn blog_show(slug: &str) -> String {
        format!("/blog/{slug}")
    }
}

#[rustfmt::skip]
pub const ROUTES: &[Route] = &[
    ("GET",  "/blog",        "blog::index", Access::Public),
    ("GET",  "/blog/{slug}", "blog::show",  Access::Public),
];

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: route mods
pub mod blog; // blog

=== create tests/app/blog_test.rs
//! Blog (src/controllers/blog/). Generated by `cargo offrails generate controller blog index show:/blog/{slug}`.
//! APP: assert what each page shows, citing its AC (`/// AC-blog-1`).

use offrails_app::routes::paths;

use crate::support::TestApp;

#[tokio::test]
async fn index_renders() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::blog())
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text("Blog");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn show_renders() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::blog_show("example"))
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text("Blog show")
        .assert_text("example");
}

=== wire tests/app/main.rs @ samples: test mods
mod blog_test; // blog
